integrity: Analytical inequalities and cited coordinate-product theorem support the asymptotic claim. A reproducible standalone Python checker tests rational rate inequalities and exhaustively enumerates small dimensions; finite tests do not prove asymptotics.
scientific_limitations: Fixed retention probability strictly between zero and one, with asymptotics for dimensions tending to infinity; the exact finite-dimensional expression applies to coordinate-prism events only. The proof invokes the published deterministic product decomposition theorem; no claim of an independent specialist proof or complete historical priority certification.
title: Sharp rare-event law for Minkowski decomposability of Bernoulli Boolean polytopes
